task.partition_policy: reuse existing train/fit/gate/sealed-confirmation IDs and bindings; no new split

shared_training.warm_start: same accepted plain state including native head and BN for all three arms
shared_training.optimizer_reset: all adaptation arms reset optimizer and scheduler; no old moments
shared_training.feature_policy: same existing prepared 128 features; retain native Euclidean-to-manifold mapping; no task-label features
shared_training.graph_policy: Bound existing simple bidirected nonself arxiv public graph; native self handling; exact five input hashes in each runtime manifest.

sage.architecture: 128->256->256->40; mean, independent root transform; BN-ReLU-dropout after first two layers
sage.head: native final SAGEConv and log_softmax
sage.task_loss: mean NLL on native log_softmax scores
sage.warm_start_source: existing accepted seed11/23/37 500-epoch matched-K15 SAGE model_state; exact CP identities supplied by release

hgcn.head: native LinearDecoder on native logmap0/proj_tan0
hgcn.task_loss: native log_softmax+NLL, implemented equivalently as mean CE on raw decoder scores; class weights all one
hgcn.adaptation: three actual message layers, arxiv dimensions, one uniform sampled training budget; no claim of prior arxiv qualification

hybonet.head: native LorentzDecoder trainable manifold prototypes and native class bias
hybonet.task_loss: mean over batch AND all 40 classes of relu(margin-score_true+score_class), including native correct-class constant
hybonet.adaptation: three actual message layers, arxiv dimensions, same sampled budget; preserve native norm/clamp and manifold optimizer

gat.operator_source: installed official PyG 2.6.1 GATConv bound in code/ADAPTERS_EUCLIDEAN.md
explicit_sampling_adaptations: Use the source-reviewed PyG block attention adapter; PyG parameter initialization is retained, not DGL initialization equivalence
Uniform-WOR minibatch dependency blocks replace the reference full-graph operator calls; softmax is over the actual sampled set plus one self edge
BatchNorm uses each layer's destination rows during training and saved moments during evaluation
500 sampled epochs are a proposed adequate-budget baseline, not the official 2000 full-batch epochs or a score reproduction
No labels in input, label iteration, symmetric attention normalization, edge dropout, or half-training-node mask
All training IDs are visited each epoch; fit-only model selection; no test or confirmation scoring

portable_note: Scientific constructor, optimizer, and stage settings retained. Historical administrative provenance removed; public CLI enables plain pretrain only.
